title: Substrate-First Memory Hierarchy Standards
description: Rules for the transition from temporal session logs to permanent Heartwood legislative state.

values.name: Chrono-Fractal Depth
values.rule: Organize active work within temporal directories; migrate finished wisdom to the root trunk.
values.rationale: Prevents context drift and maintains a clean monotonic trunk by separating temporal 'Context' from legislative 'State'.

values.name: Monotonic Growth
values.rule: The Heartwood only grows or hardens; logic is never overwritten, only versioned and archived.
values.rationale: Ensures absolute forensic accountability and prevents the loss of 'hard-won knowledge' across swarm generations.

values.name: Single Sequestration Zone
values.rule: Unwanted artifacts and metabolic residue MUST be moved to 'repos/diy-make/memory/trash/'. No other hidden or trash zones are permitted.
values.rationale: Consolidates residual entropy into a single, verifiably understood location.

values.name: Primary Logic Primacy
values.rule: Primary logical artifacts reside in 'json/' and 'py/' directories. Refined, human-centric reflections reside in 'md/'.
values.rationale: Optimizes for both machine-level forensic traceability and human-centric high-signal viewing.
